_comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, keyed by model name. THESE RATES ARE PLACEHOLDERS AND ARE NOT VERIFIED — check your provider's current pricing page before relying on --budget-usd, because a wrong rate makes the ceiling wrong in whichever direction the error runs. A model with no entry here disables --budget-usd, and passing --budget-usd for an unpriced model refuses to start rather than running without a ceiling.
